title: A cube has an inside and an outside
hook: Which figure describes space available to contents?

knows: Everyday objects have sizes, positions and amounts
doesNotKnow: Container walls consume some of its external volume. Multiplying the outer dimensions counts material as storage; subtracting both walls in each direction gives the ideal inner capacity.

misconception: The two pictured methods are interchangeable without checking their mechanism or constraints.
